name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog:
Fixes a confusing error from 0.0.70: testing a friend still on an old, pre-federation-token plugin version reported "the federation token is invalid, missing, or was revoked" - alarming and misleading, since it reads as this server's own connection breaking rather than what it actually is (the other side needs to update). Root cause: the version-mismatch detection this same release added to the Test button only ever ran after a successful connection, never on the failure path where it's actually needed - confirmed live against a real friend's server, which returns 401 (not 404) for a route an old plugin version simply doesn't have yet, identical to a genuinely revoked token from this client's point of view. The Test button now checks the remote's reported plugin version on failure too, and reports "needs to update" instead of "token invalid" when that's the real cause.

210 tests (unchanged - this is a diagnostics-only fix, no behavior change to the token model itself).
